title: Backend Developer
description: Master Backend Development — choose your own path through languages, frameworks, databases, and deployment.

tree.name: Start: Programming Fundamentals
tree.description: Variables, loops, functions, OOP — the foundation of everything.

children.name: Python
children.description: Clean syntax, massive ecosystem. Best for beginners.

children.name: Django
children.description: Batteries-included web framework. Admin panel, ORM, auth built-in.

children.name: Flask
children.description: Lightweight micro-framework. Full control, minimal boilerplate.

children.name: FastAPI
children.description: Modern, fast (async), automatic docs. Rising star in Python.

children.name: Node.js
children.description: JavaScript on the server. Same language for frontend & backend.

children.name: Express.js
children.description: Minimalist framework. Routing, middleware, REST APIs.

children.name: NestJS
children.description: Enterprise-grade framework. TypeScript, DI, modular architecture.

children.name: Java
children.description: Enterprise standard. Strong typing, massive job market in India.

tree.name: Databases
tree.description: Every backend needs data storage. Learn both SQL and NoSQL.

children.name: SQL (PostgreSQL)
children.description: Relational databases. Joins, indexes, transactions, normalization.

children.name: MongoDB
children.description: Document database. Flexible schema, great for rapid prototyping.

children.name: Redis
children.description: In-memory cache. Sessions, rate-limiting, real-time leaderboards.

tree.name: API Design
tree.description: REST, GraphQL, authentication — how services talk to each other.

children.name: RESTful APIs
children.description: HTTP verbs, status codes, JSON, CRUD operations.

children.name: GraphQL
children.description: Query exactly what you need. Type-safe, flexible, modern.

children.name: Auth (JWT/OAuth)
children.description: JWT tokens, OAuth2, session management, bcrypt.

tree.name: DevOps & Deployment
tree.description: Ship your code to production. CI/CD, containers, cloud.

children.name: Docker
children.description: Containerize your app. Consistent environments everywhere.

children.name: Cloud (AWS/GCP)
children.description: EC2, S3, Lambda, Cloud Functions. Deploy at scale.

children.name: CI/CD Pipelines
children.description: GitHub Actions, automated testing, continuous deployment.
